item.title: Iran War Live Updates: As Attacks Shake Markets, Trump Seeks to Reassure Americans
item.summary: President Trump said he would do whatever was necessary to lower oil prices, and his Treasury secretary said the government might even take the paradoxical step of lifting sanctions on some Iranian oil.

item.title: The Iran War’s Economic Threat to Europe and Asia
item.summary: Inflation and its consequences for growth are a growing concern for countries where memories of the 2022 energy crisis are fresh.

item.title: Trump and Iran Dominate the Agenda as Europe’s Leaders Meet. Here Are 4 Things to Know.
item.summary: A gathering in Brussels was meant to concentrate on jump-starting the E.U. economy. Instead, the fallout of the war in the Middle East is front and center.

item.title: U.S. Lifts Fertilizer Sanctions on Belarus as Iran War Causes Price Surge
item.summary: The Trump administration made the move in exchange for Belarus’s freeing of 250 political prisoners, part of a rapprochement between the two countries.

item.title: A Lebanese Cafe on the Edge of Destruction
item.summary: Near the center of Beirut, one image captures the aftermath of an Israeli strike.

item.title: Trump Says He Won’t Send Troops to Iran But Leaves Wiggle Room
item.summary: The president was cagey about his plans for Iran. He confirmed the Pentagon was seeking $200 billion to support a protracted war effort while also claiming it would be over soon.

item.title: Trump Administration Faces Public Jitters as Oil Prices Surge Amid Iran War
item.summary: President Trump and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel suggested that the war with Iran could end soon, but that there were still more attacks ahead.

item.title: Trump’s Reaction to Israeli Strike on Gas Field Exposes Divergent Strategies
item.summary: President Trump said he complained to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel about the attack, which sent energy markets reeling. But Israeli officials said the Americans were informed beforehand.

item.title: The Soldier Who Came Back From the Dead
item.summary: Told that Nazar Daletskyi had died, his Ukrainian family buried what they thought were his remains. He turned up three years later in a prisoner-of-war exchange.

item.title: 2 Men Charged With Spying for Iran on Jewish Institutions in UK
item.summary: The men, both Iranian citizens, are accused of conducting surveillance on several Jewish institutions and community buildings in London.
